Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Robert Barnwell Roosevelt (author, Wikidata Q655660), died 1906. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Roosevelt, Robert Barnwell, 1829-1906") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Game fish of the northern states of America, and British provinces, New York, Carleton, 1862, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/gamefishofnorthe00roos. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 94%, 88%, 94% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Robert Barnwell Roosevelt, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
